snippet.title: Devilcoin, a coin-flip roguelite — Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
A coin-flip roguelite. You traded your soul for money, and now the only way out of this occult purgatory is to keep flipping. Bet on heads or tails, collect Artifacts that bend the odds, and hit the score before your flips run out.
